Contact Samjho India — Get in Touch

Samjho is a small, independent project. If you've spotted something incorrect, have a topic you'd like explained, or found a calculator behaving unexpectedly, we'd like to know.

We read every message and try to respond within 48 hours. For urgent corrections (wrong numbers on a calculator, outdated government scheme info), mark your email as high priority so we can fix it faster.

Email

Write to us at hello@samjho.in and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

We can help with: guide corrections, calculator bugs, new topic suggestions, partnership inquiries, and general feedback about Samjho.

Before you write in

  • For a correction, please mention the exact guide or calculator page and what needs fixing.
  • For a new topic request, a short description of the question you'd like explained is enough.
  • For calculator issues, tell us which browser you're using and what numbers you entered.
  • Samjho cannot advise on your personal financial, tax or legal situation — for that, please consult a qualified professional or the relevant official authority.
Advertisement

What we cover

Samjho explains everyday Indian topics in simple language. We cover government schemes (PM Kisan, Ayushman Bharat), financial basics (GST, EMI, credit score), document guides (PAN, Aadhaar, voter ID), and education topics (CGPA, scholarships). If your question falls in these areas, we're happy to help.

For official government matters, always check the relevant government website first. Samjho explains things in plain language but is not a government service.

Social

Follow us on YouTube for video explanations of guides and calculators: youtube.com/@SamjhoIndia
